object.attr: derived: CF-E47. After a partial commit in a git client the history is kept, and undo then reverts a committed edit in the working copy, unnoticed until the next commit. Answered on 2026-11-11 (failure Q12, review Q3). Replaces MELLON-EDIT-SRS-354.
object.description: When the latest commit changes, the Document Editor shall clear the undo history.
